notes.title: Patch Notes 05/27/25
notes.content:
[b]Patch Notes[/b]

[b]Bug Fixes & Improvements[/b]
- [b]Tutorial UI Persistence[/b]: Fixed an issue where the tutorial UI would remain indefinitely after completion.
- [b]Disassemble Trigger Bug[/b]: Fixed a bug where the Disassemble passive did not trigger on the casting player’s screen.
- [b]Game Over UI Misplacement[/b]: Fixed an issue where the Game Over screen would slide off in the wrong direction.
- [b]Ice Not Clearing in Multiplayer[/b]: Fixed a bug where bots could slide on tiles that were iced earlier in the game but should have been cleared.
- [b]Jericho Hook Multiplayer Targeting[/b]: Fixed an issue where Jericho’s grappling hook could not target Socket in multiplayer matches.
- [b]Opto Passive Desync[/b]: Resolved frequent desync issues caused by Opto’s passive ability.
- [b]Nail Gun Targeting Bug[/b]: Fixed an issue where the Nail Gun could not target bots.
- [b]Network Flags on Shutdown[/b]: Closing the game now clears all network flags properly to avoid lingering data.
- [b]Slam + Disassemble Double Trigger[/b]: Fixed a bug where the Disassemble passive would trigger multiple times when activated by a slam.
- [b]End Turn Timing Bug[/b]: Players can no longer end their turn while actions (like enemy sliding) are still playing out, preventing unselectable bot issues.
- [b]Health UI Persistence[/b]: Bot health bars will now remain visible and never auto-collapse.
- [b]Attack Animation Sync[/b]: Fixed an issue where attack animations did not play for the other player in multiplayer matches.
- [b]Place Bot Timeout Cleanup[/b]: Fixed a bug where being kicked for a placement timeout didn’t correctly clean up network state.

notes.title: Patch Notes 04/07/25
notes.content:
[b]Patch Notes[/b]

[b]New Features / Additions[/b]
- [b]Shop Updates[/b]: Expanded the in-game shop with improved visuals and functionality.
- [b]Glacies Animation[/b]: Glacies now has proper animations!
- [b]Redesigned Wager UI[/b]: Overhauled the Wager Match interface for better clarity and polish.
- [b]Skin Tags in Shop[/b]: Skins you already own are now labeled with a unique colored "Owned!" tag in the shop.
- [b]Target Kill Icon[/b]: A small icon will now appear on tiles if your attack will kill a target.
- [b]Aim Direction Improvements[/b]: Players can now aim directional abilities (like Nail Gun) by hovering anywhere on the map; the closest valid direction will be automatically selected.
- [b]Post-Tutorial Info Text Toggle[/b]: The "How to Play" text wall no longer appears automatically after completing the tutorial. It is now opt-in from the main menu.

[b]Bug Fixes & Improvements[/b]
- [b]Double Damage Passive (Network)][/b]: Fixed an issue where double damage did not trigger correctly over the network.
- [b]Opto Heal Issues[/b]: Fixed two bugs: Opto’s healshot always healed double, and the +2 popup would show twice.
- [b]Root Status Lasts Forever[/b]: Fixed a bug where root would persist indefinitely after status changes.
- [b]Swap Not Completing[/b]: Fixed an issue where swap actions would occasionally not resolve.
- [b]Update Bot Placement Mechanic[/b]: Bot placement now feels more responsive and consistent.
- [b]Ability Timing Improvements[/b]: Added a short delay between ability effects to improve clarity and pacing.

notes.title: Patch Notes 03/13/25
notes.content:
[b]Patch Notes[/b]

[b]New Features / Additions[/b]
- [b]Shop & Paint Jobs[/b]: Introduced a new in-game shop where players can purchase skins and other items using in-game coins.
- [b]Coin-Based Purchases[/b]: Updated the shop so that all purchases now require in-game coins, which you earn after each match.
- [b]Remote Game Settings[/b]: Added functionality for remote game setting adjustments.
- [b]Fuel Cost Display[/b]: Ability icons now display their fuel cost, and cooldown tooltips are hidden if cooldown = 0.

[b]Bug Fixes & Improvements[/b]
- [b]Socket Knockback Issue[/b]: Fixed a bug where a Socket bot sliding on ice did not take knockback and then became unresponsive, preventing interaction.
- [b]Water & Knockback Behavior[/b]: Water now correctly functions as an obstacle or applies knockback along the outer perimeter.
- [b]Shop UI Resolution[/b]: Improved shop UI resolution for better clarity.
- [b]Jericho's Hook Over Water[/b]: Fixed an issue where Jericho’s hook over water moved the team member in the opposite direction.
- [b]Searching for a Match Bug[/b]: Fixed an issue where searching for a match sometimes required restarting the search.
- [b]Main Menu Bug[/b]: Returning to the main menu now correctly resets matchmaking, preventing issues with failing to find a game.
- [b]Fade to Black Issue[/b]: Resolved an issue where the fade-to-black transition could get stuck.
- [b]Opto Tooltip Update[/b]: Opto's tooltip now explicitly states "Cannot destroy obstacles."
- [b]Hill VFX Missing Texture[/b]: Fixed a missing texture in the hill VFX.
- [b]Subscription Handling in Maintenance Phase[/b]: Refactored the maintenance phase to ensure all subscriptions call a finished function before proceeding.
- [b]Map Selection Restrictions[/b]: You can no longer select or deselect maps while searching for a match. Map selection now happens after selecting "Find Match."
- [b]Lower Wind Volume[/b]: Adjusted wind volume for better audio balance.
- [b]Patch Notes Date[/b]: Added functionality to automatically include the date in patch notes.

notes.title: Patch Notes 02/25
notes.content:
[b]Patch Notes[/b]

[b]New Features / Additions[/b]
- [b]Unique Music Stinger[/b]: Added a unique music stinger that plays when it’s your turn.
- [b]Ignis Flame Blast LOS[/b]: Ignis Flame Blast now respects line of sight.

[b]Bug Fixes & Improvements[/b]
- [b]Deselection on Ice[/b]: Fixed a bug causing weird deselection when on ice.
- [b]Ranking Arrow Issue[/b]: Resolved an issue where ranking up displayed incorrect arrows.
- [b]Camera Functionality[/b]: Fixed camera issues to ensure smoother gameplay.
- [b]Consecutive Match Error[/b]: Addressed an error that occurred when trying to play consecutive matches.

notes.title: Patch Notes 02/12/25
notes.content:
[b]Patch Notes[/b]

[b]New Features / Additions[/b]
- [b]Skins Panel Relocation[/b]: Moved the Skins panel to the left side of the screen and added descriptive text for improved clarity.
- [b]Tile Info Panel[/b]: Added a new panel that displays detailed tile information when you left-click a tile.

[b]Bug Fixes & Improvements[/b]
- [b]Turret Tile Occupancy[/b]: Fixed an issue where turrets were not properly occupying their designated tiles.
- [b]Rusty's Shoulder Charge Animation[/b]: Slowed down Rusty's shoulder charge animation for a smoother visual experience.
- [b]Opto Shooting Over Water[/b]: Resolved an issue that prevented Opto from shooting over water.
- [b]GBL Permit Activation[/b]: Corrected the behavior so that the GBL Permit is now granted from the first mission.
- [b]Salvage Trigger Issue[/b]: Fixed a bug where Salvage was triggered twice when two sockets were present in the match.
- [b]Ragdoll Paint Job[/b]: Fixed an issue where ragdolls were not correctly applying the paint job.
- [b]NailGun ROOT Effect[/b]: Resolved an issue with the NailGun not triggering the ROOT effect when knocking units into obstacles.
- [b]Overtime Rule for 6-6 Tie[/b]: Updated the game rule so that when both teams reach 6 points simultaneously, the match continues until one team takes the lead.

notes.title: Patch Notes 01/20/2025
notes.content:
[b]Patch Notes[/b]

[b]New Features / Additions[/b]
- [b]Feedback Form[/b]: An in-game feedback form has been added, making it easier than ever to send us your thoughts.
- [b]Ranking System Tweaks[/b]: The ranking system is now more aggressive, allowing players to climb (or drop) faster.
- [b]New GIFs for Glacies and Opto[/b]: Updated visuals for these bots, including brand-new GIFs showcasing their abilities.
- [b]New/Updated Ability GIFs[/b]: Additional GIFs created to demonstrate newly added abilities and updates to existing ones.
- [b]New Tutorial Mission[/b]: A fresh tutorial mission has been introduced to help newcomers understand core mechanics more effectively.

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
- [b]Passive Icon Visibility[/b]: Fixed an issue preventing passive trait icons from showing.

notes.title: Patch Notes 12/5
notes.content:
[b]Patch Notes[/b]

[b]New Features / Additions[/b]
- [b]Comprehensive Map Selection System[/b]: We've introduced a fully revamped map selection system. Before searching for a match, players can now choose exactly which maps they want to play on. This new feature ensures more control over your gameplay experience and a more personalized match queue.
- [b]UI/UX Overhaul for Ranking[/b]: Redesigned the ranking interface and progression effects for a clearer, more rewarding path as you rank up.
- [b]Player Guidance in GBL Select[/b]: Updated the interface to direct players to review passive abilities and move styles, ensuring a better understanding of their chosen characters before battle.

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
- [b]Bots Stuck Red[/b]: Fixed an issue where bots could remain in a red state after taking damage rapidly.
- [b]NPC Pathfinding[/b]: Resolved a bug causing NPCs to fail to navigate properly.
- [b]Stop Searching Button[/b]: Fixed an issue where the Stop Searching button would not function, allowing players to properly cancel matchmaking searches.

notes.title: Patch Notes 11/11
notes.content:
[b]Patch Notes[/b]

[b]New Features / Additions[/b]
- [b]Networking[/b]: Refactored networking code to vastly improve stability
- [b]Color-Coded Passive Abilities[/b]: Added color-coded Pop-ups to indicate when passive abilities are triggered for better visual feedback.

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
- [b]Knockback not Triggering Slam[/b]: Fixed an issue where knockback was not triggering the slam effect.
- [b]Turrets Not Occupying Tiles[/b]: Resolved an issue where turrets were not occupying tiles in some cases, and refreshed the occupy system to track destructible obstacles correctly.

notes.title: Patch Notes 10/15
notes.content:
[b]Patch Notes[/b]

[b]New Features / Additions[/b]
- [b]Match Found Transition[/b]: Added visual feedback on the waiting screen when a match is found, with a smooth transition into the game.
- [b]New 3D Model for Glacies[/b]: Glacies has received a brand-new 3D model.
- [b]New VFX for Shoulder Charge[/b]: Introduced new visual effects for Rusty’s Shoulder Charge ability.
- [b]Bot Info View During Opponent's Turn[/b]: Players can now inspect both their own and enemy bots even when it is not their turn.

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
- [b]Settings Menu Flickering[/b]: Fixed an issue where the settings menu would flicker when opened.
- [b]Objective Tiles Stopping Ice Movement[/b]: Resolved an issue where objective tiles incorrectly halted ice-based movement.
- [b]Salvage Triggers Twice[/b]: Fixed a bug where the Salvage action triggered twice.
- [b]Snowball Hover Bug[/b]: Fixed an issue where snowballs stayed on tiles when hovering.
- [b]Ranking System Fix[/b]: Resolved issues with the ranking system for more accurate player ranking.
- [b]Game Packet Synchronization[/b]: Fixed a bug where game packets were sent back to the last turn. Now checks the time of the last packet and discards old packets.
- [b]Turn Tracker Bug[/b]: Created and fixed trackers (e.g., turn count at the end of the game).

[b]General Improvements[/b]
- [b]Ability Name and Description Normalization[/b]: Updated and normalized the flavor text for ability names and descriptions for better consistency.

notes.title: Patch Notes 9/09/24
notes.content:
[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Glacie Icon and Ability Update: Updated Glacie's icons and ability descriptions for better clarity.
[*] Opto Heal Projectile Visibility: Improved the visibility of Opto’s heal projectile to make it clearer during gameplay.
[/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Status Effect Phase Delay: Fixed an issue where the status effect phase was delayed.
[*] Double Damage Passive (Network Issue): Resolved a bug where the double damage passive did not properly trigger over the network.
[*] Scenario Fuel Bug: Fixed a bug where finishing a scenario with exactly 0 fuel caused the player to skip their first turn in the next scenario instance.
[*] Second Socket Mission: Fixed an issue in the second socket mission where placing the first turret did not consume fuel.
[*] Turn Not Ending After Fuel Depletion: Addressed a bug where using all fuel in a mission would not end the player’s turn.
[*] Incorrect Text on Breakable Objects: Corrected the text to clarify that players can only break cities, not mountains or trees.
[*] Controller Unresponsiveness After Leaving Game: Fixed an issue where game controllers became unresponsive after exiting the game.
[*] Rusty Shoulder Charge Desync: Resolved a desync issue where Rusty’s shoulder charge on ice caused self-damage and death for one player but not the other.
[*] Shoulder Charge Over Ice: Implemented a temporary fix to prevent damage while shoulder charging over ice to address broken mechanics.
[*] Null Reference Error: Fixed a null reference error that occurred when one player left the game.
[*] Send Feedback Button Freezing: Fixed an issue where the "Send Feedback" button would freeze the game.
[/list]

notes.title: SteamDeck & Controller Support Now Live!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We’re excited to announce that [b]braverBOTS [/b] now has full support for both SteamDeck and controllers! 

In addition, we’ve squashed various bugs to improve overall gameplay stability and performance.

notes.title: Patch Notes 8/30
notes.content:
[b][u]Game Release Notes / Patch Notes[/u][/b]

[b]New Features / Additions[/b]
- Added Two new Bots: Glacies and Opto
- Dynamic News Integration: Set up Playfab Dynamic News data for real-time updates.
- Server-Side Map Data: Changed map data to be pulled from server-authoritative JSON files to prevent desync issues.
- Multiplayer Maps: Introduced new multiplayer maps.
- Automatic Camera Focus: Implemented automatic camera focus on enemy units after a bot ends its turn.
- Snowball Mechanics: Enhanced snowball behavior to extend 1 tile past ice and continue moving forward until it hits a non-ice tile.
- Glacie Animations: Added ragdoll and placement animations for Glacie.
- Tooltip Priority: Updated tooltip priority on Opto to display "On Cooldown" before "Not Enough Fuel" when out of fuel.
- End Turn Deselect: All bots are now deselected automatically when ending a turn.

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
- Multiplayer Scoring Issue: Fixed an issue where a player could win with only 2 points in multiplayer mode.
- Jericho Teleport Desync: Resolved a desync issue caused by Jericho’s teleport ability.
- Victory Screen Performance: Addressed significant FPS drops in the victory screen for lower-end hardware.
- Socket Turret Placement: Fixed an issue where attempting to place a Socket Turret on an ice ball would consume fuel but not place the turret.
- Rusty's Hammer Lock: Fixed an issue where players could become locked into the move selector after Rusty’s hammer killed an allied Glacie on a hill.
- Rusty Knockback: Corrected Rusty's knockback direction to function as intended, knocking enemies sideways instead of forwards.
- Snowball Travel: Fixed an issue where snowballs wouldn’t travel across all ice tiles.
